prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE NEW Fashion Atlas collectible card. The two attached illustrations are CLEAN STYLE references ONLY: refined adult anime fashion illustration, intentional fine outlines, restrained matte two/three-value shading, clear cloth planes, simplified low-contrast backgrounds, slim ivory rounded border, tall portrait1:2. DO NOT copy their outfit, bob haircut, station scene or gestures. Follow this card’s own silhouette, outfit, action and hairstyle below. One ADULT woman with natural anatomy, complete head-to-toe full body and BOTH SHOES inside frame, margin around figure. Clothing is the main subject, face and hands refined but not a close-up. Individually designed purposeful action; never generic hip-pop model posing, sideways head tilt, hand touching hair or repeated crossed legs. Crisp elegant shape design, limited hair flyaways and fabric microtexture; no oily skin, no sparkling rim light, no dense golden bokeh or decorative clutter. Quiet mature expression. No text, logos, numbers, watermarks, collage, insets or extra limbs. Palette60/30/10 is approximate clothing direction, not background.
ACTION/HAIR: Full-body rear-three-quarter/side view after crossing a street. One foot just settles to a stop, torso turned toward a simple street sign at horizontal eye height. Head upright turns horizontally to read direction, no lateral tilt and no chin tilted dramatically up. One hand rests on flat shoulder-bag strap near hip, the other relaxed down; no hand at glasses. Hair: precise ASYMMETRIC JAW-LENGTH straight bob, one side tucked behind ear, clean sculptural outline, slim-frame clear glasses. Brick-red single-breasted knee-length uncinched coat worn OPEN enough to reveal high-neck black straight sleeveless column dress, ivory low-heel ankle boots and flat brick-red shoulder bag.
SCENE: Ordinary quiet street with large pale wall planes, one blank sign plate and a few crossing stripes, diffuse light. Red coat is the single strong colour field. No readable text, film logos or copied movie costume.
